description_en: Modifies the IP address whitelist of an RDS AI application instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS AI应用实例的IP白名单
kebab_example: aliyun rdsai modify-instance-ip-whitelist --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-name ra-supabase-8moov5lxba0000 --branch-name example-string --ip-whitelist 10.23.XXX.XXX --modify-mode Cover --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000 --group-name default --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceIpWhitelist

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the AI application
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The IP address whitelist. Before you modify the IP address whitelist, call the DescribeInstanceIpWhitelist operation to query the existing IP address whitelist of the instance.

<details>
<summary>Configuration rules</summary>

IP addresses (such as 10.23.XXX.XXX) and CIDR blocks (such as 10.23.XXX.XXX/24) are supported.

Separate multiple IP addresses or CIDR blocks with commas (,). Do not add spaces before or after the commas.

You can add up to 1,000 IP addresses or CIDR blocks to a single instance. If you have a large number of IP addresses, merge scattered IP addresses into CIDR blocks, such as 10.23.XXX.XXX/24.
</details>
parameters.help_zh:
IP白名单。修改IP白名单前，请调用DescribeInstanceIpWhitelist接口查询实例IP已有白名单信息。

<details>
<summary>配置规则</summary>

支持IP地址格式（如10.23.XXX.XXX）或者IP地址段格式（CIDR格式，如10.23.XXX.XXX/24）。

多个IP地址或IP地址段以英文逗号（,）分隔，且逗号前后不能有空格。

单个实例最多添加1000个IP地址或IP地址段。如果IP地址较多，建议将零散的IP地址合并为IP地址段，例如10.23.XXX.XXX/24。
</details>
parameters.name: ip_whitelist

parameters.help_en:
The modification mode. Valid values:
Cover (default): Overwrite. Overwrites the original IP address whitelist with the value of the IpWhitelist parameter.
Append: Append. Adds the IP addresses specified in the IpWhitelist parameter to the original IP address whitelist.
Delete: Delete. Deletes the corresponding whitelist group
parameters.help_zh:
修改方式，取值：
Cover（默认值）：覆盖，使用IpWhitelist参数的值覆盖原IP白名单。
Append：追加，在原IP白名单中增加IpWhitelist参数中输入的IP地址。
Delete：删除，删除对应的整个白名单分组
parameters.name: modify_mode
